ubatch_alignment_note: serial reference uses 64-token UBatch; four-sequence context uses 256 total, also 64 per sequence
rollback_protocol: after prefix, preserve the production seed at prefix; preserve accepted draft tokens; sequence-remove from prefix+1+accepted; teacher-force next token at that same position
state_difference_interpretation: compare the same-input clear/replay first; do not attribute post-rollback differences to recurrent rollback unless the replayed prefix and seed/draft rows are bitwise stable
same_input_repeat_scope: clear the four-sequence context, replay the same four prefixes and seed+three draft-prefix tokens, then compare against the first multi-prefix/teacher pass before interpreting rollback rows
negative_policy: NaN/Inf, missing comparisons, invalid geometry, max_abs>0.5, or relative_L2>0.05 remains a numeric failure; same-input reset repeat must be bitwise exact for a quality-qualified pass; rollback-replay deltas remain separately reported; explicit unresolved diagnostic mode permits only all-finite complete geometry-valid numeric differences and never marks them quality-qualified
